# index.html.md

<a id="manual-index"></a>

# XDMOD Manual

**XDMOD** (Cross-Domain MODeling) is a method plus tools for developing a product across systems
engineering, software, electronics and mechanics, in many git repos, with people and AI agents
working side by side. It is built on SYSMOD and SysML v2 for the system model, sphinx-needs for
requirements and traces, zdocs for a linked document set, and west for the workspace. Its one
tool is `curatrix`.

XDMOD gives you three things:

1. **One trace graph across all domains.** Every need, model element, CAD part, code unit and
   test result has an ID, and the more concrete side holds each link. Checks find broken, missing
   and suspect links, in every repo and across the full set.
2. **Documents that come from the design.** Requirements, architecture, CAD and code produce one
   linked, versioned document set. Generated content is committed and checked, so it can’t drift.
3. **One workflow for humans and agents.** The same commands, checks and reviews apply to
   everyone. Agents propose; only a human’s commit affirms.

Examples in this manual come from the robot arm, the worked example of XDMOD. Every page reads
on its own without it.

## How to read this manual

The manual follows Diátaxis:

- [Tutorials](tutorials/index.html.md) walk you through your first workspace, requirement and change.
- [How-to guides](howto/index.html.md) are short recipes for one task each.
- [Reference](reference/index.html.md) lists the facts: trace model, ID scheme, checks, layouts.
- [Explanation](explanation/index.html.md) says why things are the way they are, and holds every framework
  decision and method rule as a need.

The command line and the Sphinx extensions are documented in the curatrix reference
(`xdmod-ref`).

For agents and other tools, the build also writes `llms.txt` (a list of all pages),
`llms-full.txt` (all pages in one file) and a Markdown copy of every page (`<page>.md`) next
to the HTML ([*Agent-readable docs with sp... (XD-ADR-0111)*](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0111)). The needs themselves are best read from `needs.json`.

| **Every tool runs with a memory limit and a timeout**, for humans’ scripts and all agents alike. The limits are set per tool and use. # explanation/decisions/documents.html.md

<a id="adr-documents"></a>

# Documents

The linked document set, zdocs, and how documents get their content.

# explanation/decisions/index.html.md

<a id="adr-index"></a>

# Decisions

This part records every decision about the XDMOD framework. Each decision is a need of type
`xd-adr` (an *architecture decision record*), with an ID `XD-ADR-nnnn` from xdmod’s ledger
`ids.yaml`. Decisions that are only about one project that uses XDMOD (its hardware, its repos,
its GitHub settings, its licence) are kept in that project’s own documents, as `prj-dec` needs.
A project decision may `follows` a framework decision; a framework decision never links to a
project.

## How to read a decision

- `legacy_id` is the number the decision had in the planning log (`D1` to `D142`) before it
  became a need. Old texts and commit messages use these numbers.
- `date` is the day it was made.
- `decision_status` is `accepted`, `revised` (a newer decision changed part of it) or
  `superseded` (a newer decision replaced it). Changed decisions are never deleted or edited
  into something new: they keep their need, and the newer decision holds the link to them
  (`refines`, `revises` or `supersedes`). The older need shows the link back as
  “refined by”, “revised by” or “superseded by”. This is the trace rule
  [*Trace rule: the concrete si... (XD-ADR-0004)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0004) applied to decisions.
- Rules that a decision introduces are `xd-rule` needs that are `decided_by` it (see
  [Rules](explanation/rules/index.html.md)).

## How to add a decision

1. Add an `xd-adr` need to the topic page it fits, with a placeholder ID
   (`<KIND>-NEW-<tag>`, see the ID scheme), `decision_status: accepted`, `status: valid` and today’s `date`.
2. If it changes an older decision, add `refines`, `revises` or `supersedes` with the older
   ID, and set the older need’s `decision_status`.
3. Run `curatrix ids fix xdmod` to issue the ID, then `curatrix check xdmod --stage local`.

* [Method and model](explanation/decisions/method.html.md)
* [Traces and IDs](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md)
* [Documents](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md)
* [Repos and workspace](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md)
* [Checks, CI and evidence](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md)
* [Workflow and agents](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md)
* [Scope and iterations](explanation/decisions/scope.html.md)

# explanation/decisions/method.html.md

| Framework Decision: **The definition holds the trace ID** [XD-ADR-0117](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0117)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D128<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **The definition holds the trace ID** (SysML `part def`, KiCad sheet file, FreeCAD part file). Usages are listed in an `instances` field, not as separate needs. A usage gets its own ID `<ID>.<n>` only if it has its own requirement.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

| **The manifest is the only place that pins revisions.** A downstream PR’s CI builds against the upstream revisions on the manifest’s main branch. | **Repo names:** the framework (methods and tools) is **XDMOD** (“Cross-Domain MODeling”, named like SYSMOD), repo `xdmod`. Each tool in it gets a **Latin stem with a \`\`-trix\`\` suffix**, like affirmatrix and probatrix. The example repos use the prefix `robarm-` (`robarm-manifest`, `robarm-syseng`, `robarm-ee`, `robarm-me`, `robarm-sw`). Extended by [*An integration repo for sys... (XD-ADR-0066)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0066): `robarm-integration`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

| Framework Decision: **West submanifests and project groups** [XD-ADR-0079](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0079)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |

| **West submanifests and project groups.** The manifest repo splits its project list into submanifest files (one per area, e.g. framework, syseng, ee, me, sw, integration), imported by the main `west.yml`. Projects carry **groups**, so each engineer or agent checks out only what their role needs (`manifest.group-filter`). A role’s group set always includes its upstream repos and the framework ([*Upstream documents are buil... (XD-ADR-0029)*](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0029), [*xdmod is in every workspace (XD-ADR-0059)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0059)). Details are in task 3.4.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

<a id="XD-ADR-0080"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Pinned, isolated component libraries** [XD-ADR-0080](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0080)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |

| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D88<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Component libraries are pinned west projects, isolated from user-global setups.** EE uses the tiacsys KiCad libraries (`kicad-symbols`, `kicad-footprints`, `kicad-packages3D`, `kicad-templates`, `kicad-library-utils`). ME uses the FreeCAD parts library (`FreeCAD/FreeCAD-library`). KiCad projects use project-local library tables that point into the workspace through variables, and the GUI launchers ([*All commands run from the w... (XD-ADR-0060)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0060), 3.13) set those variables. FreeCAD gets its parts path from its launcher. User-global libraries are not used. The big libraries (`kicad-packages3D` about 1.8 GB, FreeCAD-library about 5.7 GB) get their own groups ([*West submanifests and proje... (XD-ADR-0079)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0079)) and shallow clones.                             |

# explanation/decisions/traces.html.md

# Traces and IDs

The trace rule, link types, need kinds and the ID scheme.

Peer interfaces (e.g. EE↔SW pin map, EE↔ME connector positions) are **interface elements in syseng**, and both domains link to them. Allocation is stored on the concrete side.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| **Small corrections from research:** (a) a drawio file “matches the model” means its content (labels, parents, edge ends, kinds, links), not its geometry ([*drawio files are committed ... (XD-ADR-0032)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0032)); (b) stubs: `concern` for stakeholder needs, `requirement` for system requirements, so SYSMOD’s `frame` link is kept ([*Read-only requirement stubs... (XD-ADR-0036)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0036)); (c) every doc build runs strict (`-W --keep-going`) with zdocs’ CI pins ([*Every check also runs locally (XD-ADR-0040)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0040)); (d) OCI tags map `baseline/vX.Y.Z` → `X.Y.Z` ([*SemVer tags and baseline tags (XD-ADR-0047)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0047)); (e) a removed requirement is first marked `retired`, and IDs are never reused; (f) devicetree trace IDs go in our own binding, never on upstream nodes; (g) CI checkouts use `fetch-depth: 0` and annotated tags; (h) link types are declared **per need type**, never globally ([*Link-type table and interfa... (XD-ADR-0030)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030)). |

| Framework Decision: **ID format DOMAIN-KIND-NNNN** [XD-ADR-0071](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0071)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D78<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>refined by: [XD-ADR-0109](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0109)<br/><br/><br/>decides: [XD-RULE-0015](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0015), [XD-RULE-0016](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0016), [XD-RULE-0017](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0017), [XD-RULE-0019](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0019)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **ID format** `<DOMAIN>-<KIND>-<NNNN>` with a 4-digit number. Domains are `SYS`, `SW`, `EE`, `ME`, `INT`. Examples: `SYS-REQ-0012`, `SW-TC-0103`, `EE-CMP-0007`. Test results: `TR-<test case ID>-<run hash>`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

<a id="XD-ADR-0072"></a>

| Framework Decision: **No project code in the sources** [XD-ADR-0072](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0072)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D79<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **No project code in the sources.** A project code with the separator `:` (e.g. `RA:SYS-REQ-0012`) is added only where IDs leave the workspace: bundles, published `needs.json`, shared affirmatrix cases.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

<a id="XD-ADR-0073"></a>

| Framework Decision: **SW test case IDs come from the ledger** [XD-ADR-0073](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0073)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D80<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **SW test case IDs** come from the ledger and are written into the ZTEST comment by a tool, like safety’s `@testid`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

<a id="XD-ADR-0104"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Tests live by what they verify** [XD-ADR-0104](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0104)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |

| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D115<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Tests live by what they verify.** A test that verifies a `SYS-REQ` or `SYS-IF` lives in robarm-integration, even if it touches one domain only. Tests of domain requirements stay in their domain repo.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

<a id="XD-ADR-0109"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Decisions become sphinx-needs** [XD-ADR-0109](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0109)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D120<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>refines: [XD-ADR-0071](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0071)<br/><br/><br/>refined by: [XD-ADR-0110](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0110)<br/><br/><br/>decides: [XD-RULE-0015](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0015)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Decisions become sphinx-needs.** Framework decisions are `XD-ADR-nnnn` in the xdmod manual. Robot-arm decisions are `PRJ-DEC-nnnn` in the `robarm` overview doc (robarm-manifest). The old D-number is kept as `legacy_id`. New ID domains `XD` and `PRJ` (extends [*ID format DOMAIN-KIND-NNNN (XD-ADR-0071)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0071)). **In rst, every mention of a decision (and of a rule or check) is a real \`\`:need:\`\` reference.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

<a id="XD-ADR-0110"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Method rules are needs** [XD-ADR-0110](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0110)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |

| **Method rules are needs** `XD-RULE-nnnn` (each `decided_by` an `XD-ADR`). | **Retiring generated needs:** status comes from the source (SysML metadata, KiCad `Status` field, FreeCAD `Status` property, Doxygen tag). Deleting without retiring first leaves a tombstone in `generated/retired-needs.json` until the next baseline. `draft` needs take part in structure checks but don’t count as coverage.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

| **ID collisions:** rulesets require PRs to be up to date with `main` before merge, and the ledger lists every issued number per kind, so that concurrent issuing conflicts in git.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |


# explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md

<a id="adr-workflow"></a>

# Workflow and agents

Branches, merging, reviews, and what agents may do.

<a id="XD-ADR-0003"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Agents are first-class** [XD-ADR-0003](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0003)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D3<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>refined by: [XD-ADR-0051](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0051)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Agents are first-class**: they edit and review design content the same way human engineers do.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

<a id="XD-ADR-0043"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Trunk-based merging with rebase** [XD-ADR-0043](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0043)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D50<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>followed by: [PRJ-DEC-0017](../../../robarm/decisions.html#PRJ-DEC-0017)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Merging:** trunk-based on `main`. Every change goes through a PR, required checks must pass, and PRs are **rebase-merged** (linear history). Enforced with org rulesets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

<a id="XD-ADR-0044"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Agents work under the user's account** [XD-ADR-0044](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0044)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D51<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>refined by: [XD-ADR-0065](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0065), [XD-ADR-0108](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0108), [XD-ADR-0123](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0123)<br/><br/><br/>decides: [XD-RULE-0042](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0042)<br/><br/><br/>followed by: [PRJ-DEC-0016](../../../robarm/decisions.html#PRJ-DEC-0016)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Agent identity:** agents work under the user’s account, and their commits carry a `Co-Authored-By` trailer. GitHub does not let you approve your own PR, so rulesets **require passing checks but no approval count**. The user’s review and merge is the approval.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

<a id="XD-ADR-0045"></a>

| Framework Decision: **One branch name across repos** [XD-ADR-0045](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0045)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D52<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>refined by: [XD-ADR-0054](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0054), [XD-ADR-0116](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0116)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Changes across repos:** the same branch name is used in every repo the change touches. CI checks out sibling repos at that branch if it exists, otherwise at the manifest pin. Upstream merges first, then one manifest PR bumps all pins.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

<a id="XD-ADR-0046"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Planning with plan.md, issues and PRs** [XD-ADR-0046](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0046)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D53<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Planning:** `plan.md` stays the master plan. Tasks become GitHub issues in the repo where the work happens, and PRs close them. An org Projects board is optional.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

<a id="XD-ADR-0051"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Only a human's commit affirms** [XD-ADR-0051](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0051)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D58<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>refines: [XD-ADR-0003](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0003)<br/><br/><br/>followed by: [PRJ-DEC-0016](../../../robarm/decisions.html#PRJ-DEC-0016)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **X3 Agents and evidence:** agents analyse suspect links and prepare affirmations and verdicts, but **only a human’s commit counts** as an affirmation or verdict. Refines [*Agents are first-class (XD-ADR-0003)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0003).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

<a id="XD-ADR-0065"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Provenance trailer on GitHub posts** [XD-ADR-0065](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0065)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: D72<br/><br/><br/>date: 2026-11-14<br/><br/><br/>decision_status: accepted<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>refines: [XD-ADR-0044](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0044)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Provenance on GitHub:** everything an agent posts on the user’s behalf (issues, comments, PR descriptions, reviews, release notes) ends with the trailer `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)`. Commits keep the `Co-Authored-By` trailer. Extends [*Agents work under the user'... (XD-ADR-0044)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0044).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

<a id="XD-ADR-0108"></a>

| Framework Decision: **Sign-off by agents** [XD-ADR-0108](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0108)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

| **Sign-off:** agents may add `Signed-off-by` in the user’s name where a repo’s convention requires it, always together with the `Co-Authored-By` trailer. The user certifies by reviewing and merging.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

# explanation/humans-and-agents.html.md

<a id="expl-humans-and-agents"></a>

# Humans and agents

In XDMOD, AI agents are first-class: they author and review design content the same way human
engineers do, with the same tools ([*Agents are first-class (XD-ADR-0003)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0003)). The difference is who may **decide**.

## Roles

| Role              | Who                                    | Does                                                                                                        |
|-------------------|----------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Owner             | a person                               | sets goals, makes decisions, reviews and merges every PR, affirms evidence, makes baselines                 |
| Domain engineer   | a person (SE, EE, ME, SW, integration) | authors and reviews content in their domain; affirms suspect links in their domain                          |
| Agent author      | an AI agent                            | authors content on a branch (requirements, model, CAD through scripts, code, tests,<br/>docs) and opens PRs |
| Agent reviewer    | an AI agent, not the author            | first-pass review of a PR against checklists; posts findings as PR comments                                 |
| Coordinator agent | the agent the owner talks to           | plans, splits work, starts other agents, gathers results, keeps the plan and the<br/>decision log           |

## Propose versus affirm

Agents analyse suspect links and prepare affirmations and verdicts. But **only a person’s commit
counts** as an affirmation or a verdict ([*Only a human's commit affirms (XD-ADR-0051)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0051)). The same holds for merging: the owner’s
review and merge is the approval ([*Agents work under the user'... (XD-ADR-0044)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0044)).

## What agents may and may not do

| Agents may                                                                                                                                                                                 | Agents may not                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| create branches, commit, push to their own branches                                                                                                                                        | merge PRs, push to `main`, force-push to other people’s branches                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| open PRs and issues and comment on them, with the provenance trailer ([*Provenance trailer on GitHu... (XD-ADR-0065)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0065))           | change repo or org settings, rulesets or secrets, or create or delete repos, without the<br/>owner’s approval of the concrete action list ([*GitHub admin by agents only... (XD-ADR-0112)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0112)) |
| add `Co-Authored-By`, and `Signed-off-by` in the owner’s name where a repo requires<br/>it ([*Sign-off by agents (XD-ADR-0108)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0108)) | affirm suspect links or give manual verdicts; they only propose them ([*Only a human's commit affirms (XD-ADR-0051)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0051))                                                                       |
| run any tool through curatrix, under limits ([*A memory limit and a timeou... (XD-ADR-0064)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0064))                                    | run tools without limits, install system packages, use sudo                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| record HIL evidence from `main` or baseline commits ([*Evidence only from main or ... (XD-ADR-0053)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0053))                            | record evidence from PR branches as anything but previews                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| post freely in the project’s own repos and in xdmod                                                                                                                                        | post on other repos (doc engine, tools, upstream projects) before the owner approved the<br/>draft ([*Posting approval outside ou... (XD-ADR-0113)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0113))                                        |

These limits are policy in iteration 1: agents work under the owner’s GitHub account
([*Agent limits are policy onl... (XD-ADR-0123)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0123)).

## Provenance

Every agent commit carries a `Co-Authored-By` trailer ([*Agents work under the user'... (XD-ADR-0044)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0044), [*Agent commits carry a trailer (XD-RULE-0042)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0042)). Everything an
agent posts on GitHub (issues, comments, PR texts, reviews) ends with the line
`🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` ([*Provenance trailer on GitHu... (XD-ADR-0065)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0065)). The check
[*commit trailers on agent co... (XD-CHECK-0028)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0028) warns about commits without the trailer.

## Review by another agent

Every pull request in the project repos and in xdmod gets a review by an agent other than the
author, before the owner’s review ([*Every PR gets an agent review (XD-ADR-0115)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0115)).

## Working in parallel

Several agents can work at the same time. Two agents never edit the same repo checkout at once.
An agent that changes repos works in its own **git worktrees** under
`<ws>/.worktrees/<branch>/<repo>`, made with `curatrix work start` ([*Parallel agents work in git... (XD-ADR-0114)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0114)). Shared,
read-only parts (Zephyr, libraries, `.venv`) are not duplicated.

Each agent gets a short brief: its goal, the decisions that bind it, the files to read, its
output paths, and what it must not do. It returns a short report; the coordinator checks the
claims that matter before passing them on.

## Agent material in the repos

Each repo has a `claude/` folder with its own rules, skills and pitfalls ([*Agent material in each repo... (XD-ADR-0062)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0062)). xdmod
holds the launch `CLAUDE.md` for the workspace root, and shared skills, commands and checklists.
The bootstrap copies the launch file to the root and links all skills and commands into
`<workspace>/.claude/` ([*The bootstrap assembles .cl... (XD-ADR-0103)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0103)). See [Repo layouts](reference/repo-layouts.html.md).
