# explanation/multi-repo.html.md

<a id="expl-multi-repo"></a>

# Many repos, one workspace

An XDMOD project lives in several git repos: one per engineering domain, one for integration,
one manifest, and the framework itself. They are managed together as one **west workspace**
([*A multi-repo workspace with... (XD-ADR-0006)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0006)).

## Why several repos

Each domain has its own tools, reviewers and pace. Separate repos keep their histories, checks
and permissions apart, while the trace links still connect them. Example (robot arm): the repos
`robarm-syseng`, `robarm-ee`, `robarm-me`, `robarm-sw` and `robarm-integration`, with
`robarm-manifest` as the manifest and `xdmod` as the framework ([*Names: XDMOD, -trix tools, ... (XD-ADR-0042)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0042)).

- The **systems engineering** repo holds needs, requirements, the SysML model and views. It is
  upstream of every domain.
- Each **domain** repo (EE, ME, SW) holds its requirements, design and domain tests.
- The **integration** repo holds the system and integration tests, the HIL setups and the
  orphan evidence branch ([*An integration repo for sys... (XD-ADR-0066)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0066)). A test that verifies a system requirement or an interface
  lives there, even if it touches one domain only ([*Tests live by what they verify (XD-ADR-0104)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0104)).
- The **manifest** repo pins every other repo ([*A dedicated manifest repo (XD-ADR-0011)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0011)), builds the full document set, and
  holds the baselines.
- **xdmod** is in every workspace that uses the framework ([*xdmod is in every workspace (XD-ADR-0059)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0059)).

## The manifest pins everything

The manifest repo is the **only** place that pins revisions ([*The manifest is the only pl... (XD-ADR-0033)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0033)). Framework and design
repos and libraries are pinned by commit SHA; third-party trees such as Zephyr may be pinned by
tag. No other repo has its own `west.yml`.

The manifest is split into **submanifests**, one per area, and its projects carry **groups**
([*West submanifests and proje... (XD-ADR-0079)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0079)). Each role checks out only what it needs, through west’s group filter. The default
filter is minimal: framework, systems engineering and Zephyr ([*A minimal default group filter (XD-ADR-0084)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0084)). A role always gets its
upstream repos and the framework. The integration role gets everything except the big CAD
libraries ([*The integration role (XD-ADR-0082)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0082)). Component libraries are pinned west projects too, isolated from any
user-global setup ([*Pinned, isolated component ... (XD-ADR-0080)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0080)).

West rule to remember: a project is active as soon as **one** of its groups is enabled. So a big
library carries only its own group, never also the domain group.

## One workspace root

The workspace root is the west topdir ([*One west topdir at the work... (XD-ADR-0061)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0061)). It holds `.west/`, `.venv/`, `build/`
and all repos. Design repos sit at the top level; dependencies go under `tools/` and `libs/`
([*Workspace paths (XD-ADR-0083)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0083)). Every command runs from the root ([*All commands run from the w... (XD-ADR-0060)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0060)). See [Workspace](reference/workspace.html.md).

## A change across repos

1. **One branch name** in every repo the change touches ([*One branch name across repos (XD-ADR-0045)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0045)).
2. **One pull request per repo.** Each lists its sibling PRs.
3. **PR CI** checks each repo against its siblings. For each sibling it takes, in this order: a
   branch with the same name; the repo’s `main` if the manifest pin is an ancestor of it; the
   manifest pin ([*PR CI sibling resolution (XD-ADR-0116)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0116)). So downstream PRs see upstream changes that are merged but not yet
   bumped.
4. **Merge upstream first**: systems engineering, then the domains, then integration. Framework
   changes merge before the repos that use them. Every PR is rebase-merged ([*Trunk-based merging with re... (XD-ADR-0043)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0043)).
5. **Bump bot.** A scheduled job in the manifest repo compares each repo’s `main` with its pin
   and opens or updates one bump PR ([*A bump bot for manifest pins (XD-ADR-0054)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0054), [*The bump bot is a scheduled... (XD-ADR-0081)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0081)). Because a PR opened with the job’s
   own token does not trigger CI, the job builds the full set itself and reports on the PR.

## Baselines and bundles

A **baseline** is a tag `baseline/vX.Y.Z` of the manifest repo: a fixed set of repo versions
([*Terms: baseline and bundle (XD-ADR-0034)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0034), [*SemVer tags and baseline tags (XD-ADR-0047)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0047)). A **bundle** is the package of outputs built from one baseline: docs,
CAM data, firmware, HIL results. Bundles come in iteration 2 ([*Scope moved to iteration 2 (XD-ADR-0037)*](explanation/decisions/scope.html.md#XD-ADR-0037)).

Before a baseline is tagged, the gates run: no links to retired needs ([*Links to retired needs are ... (XD-RULE-0011)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0011)), no open suspect
links ([*Suspect links are reviewed ... (XD-RULE-0014)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0014)), and a full local build with CAD content. The documentation is published on
GitHub Pages of the manifest repo, with `main` as “latest” and one folder per baseline
([*Docs hosting on GitHub Page... (XD-ADR-0048)*](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0048)).

## Documents across repos

Each repo has its own zdocs registry ([*One zdocs registry per repo... (XD-ADR-0021)*](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0021)), which also builds its upstream documents
locally from the west checkout, so links into upstream needs resolve ([*Upstream documents are buil... (XD-ADR-0029)*](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0029)). The manifest
repo’s registry builds the full linked set. The XDMOD manual is part of that set; project
documents link to the manual, but the manual never links to a project ([*The XDMOD manual is part of... (XD-ADR-0101)*](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0101)).


# explanation/principles.html.md

<a id="expl-principles"></a>

# Principles

XDMOD rests on a few ideas. Most rules in this manual follow from them.

## The concrete side holds the link

A trace link is written on the **more concrete** artifact and points to the more abstract one
([*Trace rule: the concrete si... (XD-ADR-0004)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0004), refined by [*Link-type table and interfa... (XD-ADR-0030)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030)). In the V-model, links point from right to left and from
bottom to top: a test case says what it verifies, a design element says what it realizes, a
domain requirement says what it refines. The abstract side never lists its children. Backlinks
such as “refined by” or “verified by” are only ever computed by the tools ([*The concrete side holds the... (XD-RULE-0001)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0001)).

Why? The concrete artifact is the one that changes most often, and its author knows what it is
for. An upstream document stays stable while downstream work goes on, and many repos can add
links to it in parallel without touching it.

Each link type belongs to the need type that owns it ([*Link types are declared on ... (XD-RULE-0002)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0002)). There is no global link
table. A link written on the wrong side, to an unknown ID or to a wrong target type fails the
build. Peer domains (for example EE and SW) never link to each other: they both link to a shared
interface need in the systems engineering repo ([*Peer interfaces live in sys... (XD-RULE-0003)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0003)). Allocation is stored on the concrete
side, too ([*Allocation is stored on the... (XD-RULE-0004)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0004)).

## Generate, commit, check

Many files are made by tools: SysML stubs for requirements, needs extracted from the model and
from CAD files, views of the model. XDMOD **commits** these files and **checks** that they still
match their sources ([*Generated files are committ... (XD-RULE-0033)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0033)). That has three benefits:

- Reviewers see the generated change in the pull request, next to the change that caused it.
- CI does not need the heavy tools (Java, KiCad, FreeCAD) to see the full trace graph
  ([*CAD-derived needs are commi... (XD-ADR-0100)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0100)).
- A stale file is a check failure, not a silent error.

Generated needs follow the same rules as authored needs ([*Generated needs follow the ... (XD-RULE-0006)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0006)).

## Text first, for people and agents

Everything that people review is text in git: reStructuredText for needs and documents
([*Requirements in sphinx-needs (XD-ADR-0005)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0005)), SysML v2 textual notation for the model ([*SysML v2 textual notation f... (XD-ADR-0001)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0001)), uncompressed FreeCAD files
and drawio views ([*Design files are stored unc... (XD-RULE-0039)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0039)). Agents edit and review this content the same way engineers do
([*Agents are first-class (XD-ADR-0003)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0003)). Diffs are readable, merges are possible, and every change goes through a pull
request.

## Documents come from the models

Documents pull content out of the design models, the way API documentation comes from code
comments ([*Documents extract content f... (XD-ADR-0017)*](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0017)). Authored rst gives the structure and the prose; Sphinx extensions add
tables, pictures and needs from SysML, KiCad, FreeCAD, code and test results.

## Every check runs locally

Every check that CI runs can also run on your machine, with one command per repo, from the
workspace root ([*Every check also runs locally (XD-ADR-0040)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0040), [*Every check runs locally (XD-RULE-0032)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0032)). Every tool runs under a memory limit and a timeout
([*A memory limit and a timeou... (XD-ADR-0064)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0064), [*Every tool runs under limits (XD-RULE-0044)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0044)), so a runaway tool cannot stall the machine or other agents.

## IDs are stable

Every need has an ID like `SYS-REQ-0012` from the repo’s ledger ([*ID format DOMAIN-KIND-NNNN (XD-ADR-0071)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0071)). An ID never
changes when its need is renamed or moved, and it is never issued again ([*IDs are never reused; retir... (XD-RULE-0020)*](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0020)). See
[ID scheme](reference/id-scheme.html.md).

| Method Rule: **Every tool runs under limits** [XD-RULE-0044](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0044)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: checks<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: checks 3<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0064](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0064)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Every tool runs with a memory limit and a timeout, so a runaway tool is stopped and can’t stall the machine.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |


# explanation/rules/ids.html.md

# ID rules

Rules for IDs and the ledger.

<a id="XD-RULE-0015"></a>

| Method Rule: **An ID matches the scheme and its need type** [XD-RULE-0015](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0015)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: ids<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: id-scheme 6.1<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0071](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0071), [XD-ADR-0109](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0109)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0003](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0003)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Every ID matches `<DOMAIN>-<KIND>-<NNNN>` (or the test result form `TR-<test case ID>-<run>`), and its kind matches the need type.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

| Method Rule: **IDs are unique** [XD-RULE-0016](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0016)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: ids<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: id-scheme 6.2<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0071](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0071), [XD-ADR-0122](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0122)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0010](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0010)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Each ID is unique within its repo and across the whole workspace.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

<a id="XD-RULE-0017"></a>

|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: ids<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: id-scheme 6.3<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0071](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0071)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0013](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0013)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

<a id="XD-RULE-0018"></a>

| Method Rule: **The ledger is never behind the sources** [XD-RULE-0018](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0018)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: ids<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: id-scheme 6.4<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0122](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0122)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0014](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0014)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Every ID of a kind that a repo owns appears in that repo’s ledger `ids.yaml`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

<a id="XD-RULE-0019"></a>

| Method Rule: **Test report IDs are mapped to TR IDs** [XD-RULE-0019](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0019)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: ids<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: id-scheme 6.5<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0071](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0071)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| sphinx-test-reports makes lowercase `tr_` IDs. The run-record extractor maps them to `TR-…` IDs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

<a id="XD-RULE-0020"></a>

| Method Rule: **IDs are never reused; retire before you delete** [XD-RULE-0020](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0020)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: ids<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: id-scheme 4<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0057](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0057), [XD-ADR-0119](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0119)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0012](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0012)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| A removed need is first marked `status: retired`, and its ID is never issued again. A generated need whose source element was deleted without retiring keeps a tombstone in `generated/retired-needs.json` until the next baseline.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |


# explanation/rules/index.html.md

<a id="rules-index"></a>

# Rules

The XDMOD method has rules: how links are written, how IDs are issued, how variants are bound,
and how repos are kept clean. Each rule is a need of type `xd-rule` with an ID
`XD-RULE-nnnn`. Each rule is `decided_by` the decision (`xd-adr`) that introduced it, and
each curatrix check that enforces a rule is an `xd-check` need that `enforces` it (see
[Checks](reference/checks.html.md)). So for every rule you can see why it exists and which check
catches a break of it. A rule without an “enforced by” link is followed by convention or by the
tools themselves, not by a check.

`legacy_id` is the name the rule had in the planning drafts, for example `R3` or `V4`, or
the place in the draft it comes from.

* [Trace rules](explanation/rules/trace.html.md)
* [ID rules](explanation/rules/ids.html.md)
* [Variant rules](explanation/rules/variants.html.md)
* [Check principles](explanation/rules/checks.html.md)

## All rules

# explanation/rules/trace.html.md

<a id="rules-trace"></a>

# Trace rules

The principles of the trace model and the rules on the trace graph.

<a id="XD-RULE-0001"></a>

| Method Rule: **The concrete side holds the link** [XD-RULE-0001](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0001)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.1<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0004](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0004), [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| A trace link is stored on the more concrete artifact. In the V-model, links point from right to left and from concrete to abstract. Backlinks such as “refined by” or “verified by” are never written; they are only computed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

<a id="XD-RULE-0002"></a>

| Method Rule: **Link types are declared on the need type that owns them** [XD-RULE-0002](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0002)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.2<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030), [XD-ADR-0057](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0057)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0001](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0001), [XD-CHECK-0002](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0002)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Every link type is declared only on the need type that holds it, in the shared needs configuration. There is no global link table. A link written on the wrong side, a link to an unknown ID, and a link to a wrong target type are build errors.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

<a id="XD-RULE-0003"></a>

| Method Rule: **Peer interfaces live in systems engineering** [XD-RULE-0003](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0003)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.3<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Interfaces between peer domains (for example EE and SW, or EE and ME) are interface needs (`SYS-IF`) in the systems engineering repo. Both domains link to the interface; neither domain links to the other.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

<a id="XD-RULE-0004"></a>

| Method Rule: **Allocation is stored on the concrete side** [XD-RULE-0004](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0004)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.4<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030), [XD-ADR-0092](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0092)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| When a logical element is allocated to a product element, the product element `realizes` the logical element. The same holds from functional to logical elements.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

<a id="XD-RULE-0005"></a>

| Method Rule: **Variants are expressed with configs and where** [XD-RULE-0005](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0005)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.5<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0092](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0092), [XD-ADR-0093](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0093)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Variants follow VAMOS through PLEML. The core is the functional and logical architecture; variants live in the 150 % product architecture. Design elements and test cases carry `configs`, requirements carry `where`, and test results carry `config`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

<a id="XD-RULE-0006"></a>

| Method Rule: **Generated needs follow the same rules** [XD-RULE-0006](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0006)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.6<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0017](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0017), [XD-ADR-0023](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0023), [XD-ADR-0100](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0100)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Needs generated from SysML, KiCad, FreeCAD, code and test results follow the same rules as authored needs. Their links come from the source files: SysML `satisfy`, CAD trace fields, Doxygen `\satisfies` and ZTEST `\verifies`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

<a id="XD-RULE-0007"></a>

| Method Rule: **One shared needs configuration** [XD-RULE-0007](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0007)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.7<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030), [XD-ADR-0057](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0057)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| One module in xdmod (`needs/needs_config.toml`) defines all need types, fields and link types. Every document of every repo uses it, and the reference tables are generated from it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

<a id="XD-RULE-0008"></a>

| Method Rule: **Every system requirement is refined or satisfied** [XD-RULE-0008](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0008)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: R1<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0006](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0006)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Every `SYS-REQ` is refined by at least one domain requirement or satisfied by at least one `SYS-EL`. Needs with `status: draft` don’t count. Checked over the full set, because the links come from other repos.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

<a id="XD-RULE-0009"></a>

| Method Rule: **Every requirement is verified** [XD-RULE-0009](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0009)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: R2<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0090](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0090), [XD-ADR-0094](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0094)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0007](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0007)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Every requirement (`SYS-REQ` and the domain requirements) has at least one `verifies` link pointing at it, per applicable configuration. It is a warning in iteration 1 and an error at the baseline gate from iteration 2.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

<a id="XD-RULE-0010"></a>

| Method Rule: **No orphan design elements** [XD-RULE-0010](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0010)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: R3<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0004](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0004)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Every product-layer `SYS-EL`, `SW-ARCH`, `EE-PCBA`, `EE-CMP`, `ME-ASM` and `ME-PART` has a `realizes` or a `satisfies` link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

<a id="XD-RULE-0011"></a>

| Method Rule: **Links to retired needs are reported, with a grace period** [XD-RULE-0011](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0011)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: R4<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0057](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0057), [XD-ADR-0068](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0068)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0008](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0008)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| A link to a need with `status: retired` is reported. On `main` and in pull requests it is a warning that does not fail the build. The baseline build fails while any such link remains.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

<a id="XD-RULE-0012"></a>

| Method Rule: **HIL results carry the firmware hash and the pinned SHAs** [XD-RULE-0012](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0012)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: R5<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0050](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0050), [XD-ADR-0053](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0053)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0005](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0005)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Every `TR` from a hardware-in-the-loop run carries `firmware_sha256` and the SHAs of all pinned repos it depends on.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

<a id="XD-RULE-0013"></a>

| Method Rule: **Only valid evidence counts** [XD-RULE-0013](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0013)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: R5a<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0120](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0120)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0011](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0011)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| A `TR` counts only if its recorded SHAs (and firmware hash) match the current manifest pins on `main`, or the baseline being built. Otherwise it is shown as stale and does not count for coverage.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

<a id="XD-RULE-0014"></a>
