| Method Rule: **Suspect links are reviewed before a baseline** [XD-RULE-0014](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0014)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: R7<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0038](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0038), [XD-ADR-0052](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0052), [XD-ADR-0121](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0121)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0024](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0024)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| A link is suspect when its target changed after the link was last confirmed. Until affirmatrix is adapted, “last confirmed” means the `needs.json` of the last baseline (for pull requests: of `main`). A change is a change of title, content, status, value fields or links. Suspect links are reported in pull requests and block a baseline.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |


# explanation/rules/variants.html.md

<a id="rules-variants"></a>

# Variant rules

Rules for the feature model (F), the product models (V) and the traces of variants (T). Iteration 1 checks [*A configuration respects it... (XD-RULE-0021)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0021), [*Feature constraints hold (XD-RULE-0022)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0022) and [*One product model per confi... (XD-RULE-0023)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0023) to [*Exactly one variant per var... (XD-RULE-0027)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0027).

<a id="XD-RULE-0021"></a>

| Method Rule: **A configuration respects its feature tree** [XD-RULE-0021](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0021)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: F1<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0009](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0009)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| A configuration sets only features of its feature tree, and every feature group keeps its multiplicity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

<a id="XD-RULE-0022"></a>

| Method Rule: **Feature constraints hold** [XD-RULE-0022](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0022)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: F2<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0009](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0009)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Every requires, xor and implies constraint of the feature model holds in every configuration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

<a id="XD-RULE-0023"></a>

| Method Rule: **One product model per configuration** [XD-RULE-0023](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0023)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: V1<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0009](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0009)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Every product model names an existing configuration, and every configuration has exactly one product model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

<a id="XD-RULE-0024"></a>

| Method Rule: **Every variation is bound** [XD-RULE-0024](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0024)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: V2<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0009](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0009)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| The product model binds every variation of the 150 % model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

<a id="XD-RULE-0025"></a>

| Method Rule: **A variation is bound to its own variant** [XD-RULE-0025](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0025)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: V3<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0009](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0009)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Each variation is bound to one of that variation’s own variants.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

<a id="XD-RULE-0026"></a>

| Method Rule: **The chosen variant is enabled** [XD-RULE-0026](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0026)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: V4<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0009](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0009)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| The chosen variant is enabled by the configuration: all features it is bound to are chosen. Several bindings on one element mean AND.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

<a id="XD-RULE-0027"></a>

| Method Rule: **Exactly one variant per variation** [XD-RULE-0027](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0027)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: V5<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0009](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0009)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Exactly one variant of each variation is enabled per configuration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

<a id="XD-RULE-0028"></a>

| Method Rule: **Model constraints hold in each product model** [XD-RULE-0028](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0028)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: V6<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| The `assert constraint` statements of the 150 % model hold in each product model (simple `==`, `implies`, `and`, `or` only).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

<a id="XD-RULE-0029"></a>

| Method Rule: **configs matches the source** [XD-RULE-0029](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0029)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: T1<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0093](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0093), [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| The `configs` of a generated need equals what the model, CAD or build says.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

<a id="XD-RULE-0030"></a>

| Method Rule: **realizes respects configurations** [XD-RULE-0030](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0030)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: T2<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| A `realizes` link is allowed only if the source’s `configs` is a subset of the target’s `configs`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

<a id="XD-RULE-0031"></a>

| Method Rule: **Coverage counts per configuration** [XD-RULE-0031](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0031)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: variants<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: T3<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0094](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0094), [XD-ADR-0095](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| A `TR` counts for a requirement in a configuration only under the coverage rule: with `verification_scope: logical` a result from any configuration counts; with `verification_scope: config` a result is needed for each configuration that the requirement’s `where` selects.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |


# explanation/sysmod-and-sysml.html.md

<a id="expl-sysmod-and-sysml"></a>

# SYSMOD and SysML v2

XDMOD uses the SYSMOD method by Tim Weilkiens for systems engineering ([*SYSMOD is the main method r... (XD-ADR-0007)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0007)), and writes the
system model in SysML v2 textual notation ([*SysML v2 textual notation f... (XD-ADR-0001)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0001)).

## Why SYSMOD

SYSMOD gives a fixed order of steps and names for their work products: problem statement,
stakeholders, needs, system context, use cases, requirements, and the functional, logical and
product architecture. XDMOD keeps SYSMOD’s order and names, so the SYSMOD website
([https://mbse4u.com/sysmod/](https://mbse4u.com/sysmod/)) and its examples apply directly. The SYSMOD v5 library
(`mbse4u/sysmod-sysmlv2`) is a west project pinned at a commit, not a copy ([*The SYSMOD library is a pin... (XD-ADR-0077)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0077)).

## Two worlds: text and model

- **Text that people review lives in sphinx-needs**: stakeholder needs, requirements, test
  specifications ([*Requirements in sphinx-needs (XD-ADR-0005)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0005)).
- **Structure and behaviour live in SysML**: context, use cases, architecture, allocations,
  variants.

The two worlds meet through **generated stubs** ([*Read-only requirement stubs... (XD-ADR-0036)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0036)). A tool reads the needs and writes a
package of read-only stubs: a `concern` for each stakeholder need and a `requirement` for each
system requirement ([*Small corrections from rese... (XD-ADR-0057)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0057) (b)). Model elements refer to requirements through these stubs,
for example with `satisfy`. Nobody edits the stubs by hand; a check compares them with the
needs ([*SysML stubs match the needs (XD-CHECK-0015)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0015)).

The other way, model elements come back into the documents as generated needs. A model element
becomes a need only when it takes part in a trace link ([*Only linked model elements ... (XD-ADR-0118)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0118)). The definition holds the
ID; its usages are listed in an `instances` field ([*The definition holds the tr... (XD-ADR-0117)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0117)). The model extractor writes
`generated/model-needs.json`, which is committed and checked ([*model.json and model-needs.... (XD-CHECK-0017)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0017)).

## Requirement values

SYSMOD’s requirement boilerplates give requirements machine-readable values. XDMOD keeps the EARS
sentence for people ([*Requirements use EARS (XD-ADR-0009)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0009), [*EARS for system and domain ... (XD-ADR-0039)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0039)) and adds value fields next to it: `quantity`,
`unit`, `min`, `max`, `nominal` ([*Requirement values are need... (XD-ADR-0076)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0076)). The stub carries them as attributes, so a
model constraint or a test can read them. Checks compare the fields with the sentence
([*Requirement values agree wi... (XD-RULE-0036)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0036), [*Requirements use EARS patterns (XD-RULE-0037)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0037)).

## Problem statement and objectives

The problem statement is a stakeholder need with `category: problem` ([*The problem statement is a ... (XD-ADR-0074)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0074)). System
objectives are stakeholder needs with `category: objective` ([*System objectives are stake... (XD-ADR-0075)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0075)). Other needs and
objectives link to the problem statement with `addresses`.

## The chain of contexts

SYSMOD builds a chain of contexts, each one specialising the one before: idea, specification,
functional, logical and product context. Later contexts inherit actors and ports. XDMOD includes
a short functional architecture: functions realize use cases, and logical elements realize
functions ([*A short functional architec... (XD-ADR-0078)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0078)). Each system element (`SYS-EL`) carries a `layer`: `context`,
`functional`, `logical` or `product`.

## Toolchain

The model is checked with the OMG SysML v2 Pilot Implementation, run through `jshell`, which
also exports the model as JSON ([*SysML toolchain: the OMG Pi... (XD-ADR-0058)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0058)). XDMOD’s own Python tools read that JSON. curatrix
stores a compact form of it in `generated/model.json`, so later steps (views, variants, needs)
need no Java. The model must parse with 0 errors ([*The SysML model parses with... (XD-RULE-0035)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0035), [*the Pilot parses the model ... (XD-CHECK-0016)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0016)).

Views of the model are SysML `view` definitions with an `@XdView` annotation ([*View definitions live in th... (XD-ADR-0085)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0085)).
curatrix renders them as editable `.drawio.svg` files ([*Views are committed as edit... (XD-ADR-0087)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0087)).

The step-by-step mapping from SYSMOD steps to files and documents is in
[SYSMOD mapping](reference/sysmod-mapping.html.md).


# explanation/v-model-and-traces.html.md

<a id="expl-v-model-and-traces"></a>

# The V-model and trace links

XDMOD arranges the work products of a project along a V. The left side goes from stakeholder
needs down to the design of each domain. The right side goes from code and parts up to the system
tests. Trace links connect the two sides and the levels.

## The picture

Links point to the left and upwards. Each arrow is written on the artifact at its tail.

```text
SYS-STH  SYS-NEED <-addresses-- SYS-UC
            ^ refines
         SYS-REQ <------------ verifies ------------ INT-STC <-result_of- TR
            ^ satisfies     ^ refines
         SYS-EL (logical)   |            SYS-IF <-verifies-- INT-ITC <-result_of- TR
            ^ realizes      |               ^ conforms
         SYS-EL (product,  SW-REQ / EE-REQ / ME-REQ <-verifies-- SW-TC / EE-TC / ME-TC <-result_of- TR
                 150 %)          ^ satisfies
            ^ realizes        |
         SW-ARCH / EE-PCBA / EE-CMP / ME-ASM / ME-PART <-refines / part_of- SW-DD / EE-CMP / ME-PART
                                                   ^ implements (+ optional satisfies -> SW-REQ)
                                                SW-IMPL (code)
```

The exact rules (which type may link to which, and how many links are required) are in
[Trace model](reference/trace-model.html.md).

## Who holds the link

The more concrete side holds the link ([*The concrete side holds the... (XD-RULE-0001)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0001)). A requirement in the SW domain says which
system requirement it refines; a test case says which requirement it verifies; a part says
which system element it realizes. This keeps upstream documents stable while downstream repos
grow.

Peer domains do not link to each other. When EE and SW must agree on a pin map, or EE and ME on
a connector position, the agreement is an **interface** need (`SYS-IF`) in the systems
engineering repo. Both domains link to it with `conforms`, and tests of it are integration
tests ([*Link-type table and interfa... (XD-ADR-0030)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030), [*Tests live by what they verify (XD-ADR-0104)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0104)).

Allocation is stored on the concrete side as well: a product element `realizes` the logical
element it was allocated from ([*Allocation is stored on the... (XD-RULE-0004)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0004)).

## Links across repos

Each repo builds its own documents plus its upstream documents from the west checkout, so a
link into an upstream need resolves in the local build ([*Upstream documents are buil... (XD-ADR-0029)*](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0029)). Rules that need the whole
graph, such as “every system requirement is refined or satisfied” ([*Every system requirement is... (XD-RULE-0008)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0008)), run in curatrix’s
own graph check, because the sphinx-needs schema skips imported needs. They always run in the
full-set build.

## Graph rules

Beyond the shape of each need, XDMOD checks the graph:

- every system requirement is refined or satisfied ([*Every system requirement is... (XD-RULE-0008)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0008), [*every SYS-REQ refined or sa... (XD-CHECK-0006)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0006));
- every requirement is verified, per configuration ([*Every requirement is verified (XD-RULE-0009)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0009), [*every requirement verified ... (XD-CHECK-0007)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0007));
- no orphan design elements ([*No orphan design elements (XD-RULE-0010)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0010), [*no orphans (R3) (XD-CHECK-0004)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0004));
- links to retired needs are reported, with a grace period until the next baseline
  ([*Links to retired needs are ... (XD-RULE-0011)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0011), [*no links to retired needs (... (XD-CHECK-0008)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0008));
- HIL results carry the firmware hash and the pinned SHAs ([*HIL results carry the firmw... (XD-RULE-0012)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0012), [*HIL results carry firmware ... (XD-CHECK-0005)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0005)), and only
  results that match the current pins count ([*Only valid evidence counts (XD-RULE-0013)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0013), [*stale evidence (R5a) (XD-CHECK-0011)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0011));
- suspect links are found and must be confirmed before a baseline ([*Suspect links are reviewed ... (XD-RULE-0014)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0014), [*suspect links against the l... (XD-CHECK-0024)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0024)).

## Suspect links

A link is **suspect** when its target changed after the link was last confirmed. Example: a
system requirement’s value changes from 50 ms to 20 ms; every SW requirement that refines it may
now be wrong.

Until the suspect-link tool affirmatrix is adapted ([*affirmatrix is adapted thro... (XD-ADR-0052)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0052)), “last confirmed” means the
`needs.json` of the last baseline (for pull requests: of `main`). A change is a change in the
hashed fields: title, content, `status`, value fields and links ([*Suspect links before affirm... (XD-ADR-0121)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0121)). In a pull
request, `curatrix needs-diff` lists the changed needs and the links that became suspect
([*needs-diff against the base... (XD-CHECK-0023)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0023)). Before a baseline every suspect link must be confirmed. Agents may prepare the
confirmation, but only a person’s commit counts ([*Only a human's commit affirms (XD-ADR-0051)*](explanation/decisions/workflow.html.md#XD-ADR-0051)).

## Retiring needs

A need is never just deleted. It first gets `status: retired` ([*Small corrections from rese... (XD-ADR-0057)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0057) (e)). Links to it
stay valid until the next baseline, and the checks report them as warnings ([*A grace period for retired ... (XD-ADR-0068)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0068)). The
baseline build fails while any such link remains. Generated needs take their status from their
source; if a source element is deleted without being retired, curatrix keeps a tombstone until
the next baseline ([*Retiring generated needs (XD-ADR-0119)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0119), [*tombstones of deleted gener... (XD-CHECK-0012)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0012)).

## Evidence

Test results (`TR` needs) are the evidence on the right side of the V. A result counts only if
the SHAs it recorded (and the firmware hash) match the current pins on `main` or the baseline
being built ([*Evidence validity (XD-ADR-0120)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0120)). Evidence is recorded only from commits on `main` or baseline tags;
runs on pull-request branches are previews ([*Evidence only from main or ... (XD-ADR-0053)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0053)). HIL run records live on an orphan
evidence branch in the integration repo ([*An integration repo for sys... (XD-ADR-0066)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0066)).

## Coverage per configuration

When a product line has several configurations, coverage is a matrix: requirements down,
configurations across ([*Coverage per configuration (XD-ADR-0094)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0094)). A requirement’s `verification_scope` says whether
evidence from any configuration counts (`logical`) or whether each applicable configuration
needs its own evidence (`config`). See [Variants](explanation/variants.html.md).


# explanation/variants.html.md

<a id="expl-variants"></a>

# Variants

A project often builds more than one product from one design: a prototype and a product, a
small and a large version. XDMOD models these as **variants of one product line**, following
VAMOS ([*Variants follow VAMOS throu... (XD-ADR-0092)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0092)).

## VAMOS and PLEML

VAMOS, by Tim Weilkiens, is a variant method for SysML v1. XDMOD uses **PLEML** (MBSE4U, MIT
licence), its SysML v2 successor. PLEML is a west project pinned at a commit, next to the SYSMOD
library. SYSMOD v5 itself has no variant concept.

The parts of a variant model:

| Part                       | What it is                                                                                                                  |
|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Core                       | The variant-free functional and logical architecture.                                                                       |
| Feature model              | Features and feature groups, with constraints such as `requires` and `xor`.                                                 |
| 150 % product architecture | The product architecture with **variation points**. Each variation has variants, and<br/>each variant is bound to features. |
| Configurations             | A choice of features. Each configuration has exactly one product model.                                                     |

Example (robot arm): the feature group `buildKind` has the features `prototypeBuild` and
`productBuild`. The variation `controller` has the variants `nucleoBreakouts` (bound to
`prototypeBuild`) and `customPcba` (bound to `productBuild`). The configurations are
`prototype` (`SYS-CFG-0001`) and `product` (`SYS-CFG-0002`).

## Variant fields on needs

Needs carry their variant information in fields ([*Variant fields configs, whe... (XD-ADR-0093)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0093), [*Variants are expressed with... (XD-RULE-0005)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0005)):

- `configs` on product-layer system elements, domain design elements and test cases: the
  configurations the element belongs to. Empty means all.
- `where` on requirements: a feature condition, matching the EARS “Where <feature>, the system
  shall …” pattern. Empty means all configurations.
- `verification_scope` on requirements: `logical` or `config` (see below).
- `config` on test results: the one configuration the run was made on.

Configurations and features have their own ID kinds, `SYS-CFG` and `SYS-FEAT`
([*IDs for configurations and ... (XD-ADR-0097)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0097)). They are written as SysML short names.

## Why own checks

The SysML Pilot checks none of the variant rules: in a test it accepted every planted error. So
curatrix checks them itself ([*Variant rules (XD-ADR-0095)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0095), [*variant rules F1, F2, V1-V5 (XD-CHECK-0009)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0009)). The rules cover the feature model
([*A configuration respects it... (XD-RULE-0021)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0021), [*Feature constraints hold (XD-RULE-0022)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0022)), the product models ([*One product model per confi... (XD-RULE-0023)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0023) to [*Model constraints hold in e... (XD-RULE-0028)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0028)) and the trace links
([*configs matches the source (XD-RULE-0029)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0029) to [*Coverage counts per configu... (XD-RULE-0031)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0031)). They are listed in [Variant rules](reference/variant-rules.html.md). Several feature
bindings on one element mean AND ([*The chosen variant is enabled (XD-RULE-0026)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0026)); PLEML does not say this, so it is an XDMOD
convention.

## Coverage per configuration

The coverage report is a requirement × configuration matrix ([*Coverage per configuration (XD-ADR-0094)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0094)). A cell is covered
when:

- `verification_scope: logical`: at least one test result from **any** configuration verifies
  the requirement. Example: SW logic tested on the prototype also counts for the product.
- `verification_scope: config`: at least one result with `config` = C verifies it, for each
  configuration C that the requirement’s `where` selects.

The verification rule [*Every requirement is verified (XD-RULE-0009)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0009) applies per cell.

## One document set

There is **one variant-aware document set** ([*One variant-aware document set (XD-ADR-0096)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0096)), not one set per variant. Documents show
the 150 % content with configuration badges. A generated page per configuration lists the
elements and requirements that apply to it, and its column of the coverage matrix.

## What iteration 1 covers

Iteration 1 starts with one feature group and the rules [*A configuration respects it... (XD-RULE-0021)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0021), [*Feature constraints hold (XD-RULE-0022)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0022) and [*One product model per confi... (XD-RULE-0023)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0023) to
[*Exactly one variant per var... (XD-RULE-0027)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0027) ([*Scope cuts for iteration 1 (XD-ADR-0124)*](explanation/decisions/scope.html.md#XD-ADR-0124)). The rule [*Model constraints hold in e... (XD-RULE-0028)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0028), the derivation of `configs` for [*configs matches the source (XD-RULE-0029)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0029), and
the pages per configuration come later.


# howto/add-a-configuration.html.md

<a id="howto-add-a-configuration"></a>

# Add a feature or configuration

Use this guide when the product line gets a new feature, a new variant at a variation point, or
a new configuration. Variants follow VAMOS in SysML v2 through PLEML ([*Variants follow VAMOS throu... (XD-ADR-0092)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0092)).

## Steps

1. **Feature.** Add it to the feature model (`features.sysml`) with a `SYS-FEAT` short-name
   ID ([*IDs for configurations and ... (XD-ADR-0097)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0097)). Add constraints such as `requires` or `xor` there.
2. **Variant.** In the 150 % product architecture (`product.sysml`), add the variant to its
   `variation part` and bind it to features with PLEML feature bindings. Several bindings on
   one element mean AND ([*The chosen variant is enabled (XD-RULE-0026)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0026)).
3. **Configuration.** In `configs.sysml`, add the configuration with a `SYS-CFG` ID and
   exactly one product model that binds every variation ([*One product model per confi... (XD-RULE-0023)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0023), [*Every variation is bound (XD-RULE-0024)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0024)).
4. **Fields.** Elements that belong only to some configurations carry `configs`; requirements
   that apply only to some carry `where` ([*Variant fields configs, whe... (XD-ADR-0093)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0093), [*Variants are expressed with... (XD-RULE-0005)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0005)). Set `verification_scope`
   on requirements ([*Coverage per configuration (XD-ADR-0094)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0094)).
5. Issue the IDs and regenerate:
   ```sh
   curatrix ids fix robarm-syseng
   curatrix gen model robarm-syseng
   curatrix variants robarm-syseng -v
   ```

## Checks

- [*variant rules F1, F2, V1-V5 (XD-CHECK-0009)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0009) runs the variant rules [*A configuration respects it... (XD-RULE-0021)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0021), [*Feature constraints hold (XD-RULE-0022)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0022) and [*One product model per confi... (XD-RULE-0023)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0023) to [*Exactly one variant per var... (XD-RULE-0027)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0027). All
  are errors.

#### NOTE
Iteration 1 checks [*A configuration respects it... (XD-RULE-0021)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0021), [*Feature constraints hold (XD-RULE-0022)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0022) and [*One product model per confi... (XD-RULE-0023)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0023) to [*Exactly one variant per var... (XD-RULE-0027)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0027) only
([*Scope cuts for iteration 1 (XD-ADR-0124)*](explanation/decisions/scope.html.md#XD-ADR-0124)). [*Model constraints hold in e... (XD-RULE-0028)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0028), the derivation of `configs` ([*configs matches the source (XD-RULE-0029)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0029)), [*realizes respects configura... (XD-RULE-0030)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0030),
[*Coverage counts per configu... (XD-RULE-0031)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0031), the coverage per configuration and the per-configuration pages come later.

## Pitfalls

- The Pilot accepts models that break every variant rule. Only `curatrix variants` finds them.
- A `realizes` link from an element that exists in more configurations than its target breaks
  [*realizes respects configura... (XD-RULE-0030)*](explanation/rules/variants.html.md#XD-RULE-0030) once that rule is checked.


# howto/add-a-model-element.html.md

<a id="howto-add-a-model-element"></a>

# Add a model element

Use this guide when you add a SysML element that takes part in a trace link: a function, a
logical or product part, an interface, a use case, a feature or a configuration.

Only model elements with trace links become needs ([*Only linked model elements ... (XD-ADR-0118)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0118)). Elements without links stay in
the model only and need no ID.

## Steps

1. Pick the file of the SYSMOD step ([*SYSMOD is the main method r... (XD-ADR-0007)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0007)): for example `functional.sysml` (10a),
   `logical.sysml` (10b), `product.sysml` (10c), `features.sysml` and `configs.sysml`
   (10d). The mapping is in the SYSMOD mapping reference.
2. Give the **definition** a short-name placeholder ID. The definition holds the ID; its usages
   are listed in the need’s `instances` field ([*The definition holds the tr... (XD-ADR-0117)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0117)).
   ```text
   @XdTrace::Trace { layer = "logical"; }
   part def <'SYS-EL-NEW-ctrl'> JointController { ... }
   ```
3. Set the layer with `@XdTrace::Trace` on the element or its package (`context`,
   `functional`, `logical`, `product`, [*A short functional architec... (XD-ADR-0078)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0078)).
4. Add the links:
   - `satisfy sys_req_0012 by ctrl;` makes the element satisfy `SYS-REQ-0012`, through the
     generated requirement stub.
   - `allocate <T> to <S>;` between usages makes `S` realize `T`. The concrete side holds
     the link ([*Allocation is stored on the... (XD-RULE-0004)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0004)).
5. Issue the ID and regenerate the model files:
   ```sh
   curatrix ids fix robarm-syseng
   curatrix gen model robarm-syseng
   ```

   This writes `generated/model.json` and `generated/model-needs.json`. Commit both.

## Checks

```sh
curatrix check robarm-syseng --stage local
```

- [*the Pilot parses the model ... (XD-CHECK-0016)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0016): the Pilot parses the model with 0 errors ([*The SysML model parses with... (XD-RULE-0035)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0035)).
- [*model.json and model-needs.... (XD-CHECK-0017)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0017): the committed model files match the model ([*Generated files are committ... (XD-RULE-0033)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0033)).
- [*no orphans (R3) (XD-CHECK-0004)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0004): a product-layer element realizes or satisfies something ([*No orphan design elements (XD-RULE-0010)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0010)).
- [*views match the model (cont... (XD-CHECK-0018)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0018): views that show the element are up to date (see [Add a view](howto/add-a-view.html.md)).

## Pitfalls

- [*the Pilot parses the model ... (XD-CHECK-0016)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0016) and [*model.json and model-needs.... (XD-CHECK-0017)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0017) need Java and the Pilot. Run `curatrix doctor` if they fail to start.
- A link that is not `satisfy`, `allocate` or `dependency` between known kinds is a finding.
- If you delete a traced element without setting `status = "retired"` first, curatrix keeps a
  tombstone in `generated/retired-needs.json` until the next baseline ([*Retiring generated needs (XD-ADR-0119)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0119),
  [*tombstones of deleted gener... (XD-CHECK-0012)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0012)).


# howto/add-a-part.html.md

<a id="howto-add-a-part"></a>

# Add a FreeCAD part or assembly

Use this guide when you add a FreeCAD part (`ME-PART`) or assembly (`ME-ASM`) that takes part
in trace links.

## Steps

1. Start FreeCAD with the launcher. It uses a workspace-local config that saves `.FCStd` files
   **uncompressed** and points at the pinned parts library ([*FreeCAD files uncompressed,... (XD-ADR-0056)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0056), [*Pinned, isolated component ... (XD-ADR-0080)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0080)):
   ```sh
   curatrix launch freecad robarm-me/parts/link.FCStd
   ```
2. Add string properties in the group `Trace` to the part or assembly object: `TraceID`,
   `Realizes`, `Satisfies`, `Conforms`, `PartOf`, `Status`, `Configs`. They mean the
   same as the KiCad fields ([Add a PCBA or circuit block](howto/add-a-pcba.html.md)).
3. Set the `TraceID` to a real ID. Placeholders inside `.FCStd` files are refused, so issue
   the ID first:
   ```sh
   curatrix ids new ME-PART --repo robarm-me
   ```
4. Keep parameters in a spreadsheet with aliases. The `freecad-params` directive shows them in
   the docs, also in CI.
5. Regenerate the CAD needs and the semantic JSON, and commit both with the part:
   ```sh
   curatrix gen cad-needs robarm-me
   curatrix gen freecad-json robarm-me
   ```

## Checks

-  [*.FCStd uncompressed; drawio... (XD-CHECK-0025)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0025): the `.FCStd` is stored uncompressed ([*Design files are stored unc... (XD-RULE-0039)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0039)).
- [*cad-needs.json matches the ... (XD-CHECK-0019)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0019): `cad-needs.json` matches the FreeCAD files.
- [*generated files record the ... (XD-CHECK-0020)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0020): the generated files record the tool versions that made them.

For review, `git diff` shows `.FCStd` changes as semantic JSON through the textconv driver
that the bootstrap installs. GitHub does not, so reviewers read the committed JSON.

#### NOTE
The full review report (drawing SVGs, image diff, 3D views) stays local in iteration 1
([*Scope cuts for iteration 1 (XD-ADR-0124)*](explanation/decisions/scope.html.md#XD-ADR-0124)). Publishing it as a Pages preview ([*FreeCAD review report as a ... (XD-ADR-0098)*](explanation/decisions/scope.html.md#XD-ADR-0098)) comes later. TechDraw and GLB
exports are not implemented yet.

## Pitfalls

- `.FCStd` files can’t be merged. On a conflict, take one side and redo the other change.
- An unchanged save still changes the file. The pre-commit hook warns when a `.FCStd` changed
  but its semantic JSON didn’t.


# howto/add-a-pcba.html.md

<a id="howto-add-a-pcba"></a>

# Add a PCBA or circuit block

Use this guide when you add a KiCad project (a PCBA), a circuit block or a component that takes
part in trace links. Prototype wiring is EE content too: a KiCad schematic of the prototype
setup whose elements carry `configs` ([*Prototype wiring is EE content (XD-ADR-0067)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0067)).

Trace IDs live inside the KiCad files ([*Trace IDs live inside the C... (XD-ADR-0023)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0023)). The docs read them from there.

## Steps

1. Make the KiCad project in the EE repo (e.g. `pcba/<name>/`). Use only the workspace
   libraries: start KiCad with the launcher, which sets the library paths and keeps your
   user-global setup out ([*Pinned, isolated component ... (XD-ADR-0080)*](explanation/decisions/repos.html.md#XD-ADR-0080)):
   ```sh
   curatrix launch kicad robarm-ee/pcba/<name>/<name>.kicad_sch
   ```
2. For the PCBA itself, set text variables in `<name>.kicad_pro`. For circuit blocks and
   components, add **hidden** symbol or sheet fields:

   | Field       | Value                                                                           |
   |-------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
   | `TraceID`   | the need ID (kind `EE-PCBA` or `EE-CMP`); write a placeholder ID, then issue it |
   | `Realizes`  | the product-layer `SYS-EL` IDs (comma list)                                     |
   | `Satisfies` | `EE-REQ` IDs                                                                    |
   | `Conforms`  | `SYS-IF` IDs of the interfaces it meets                                         |
   | `PartOf`    | the `EE-PCBA` ID                                                                |
   | `Status`    | `draft`, `valid` or `retired`                                                   |
   | `Configs`   | `SYS-CFG` IDs, if it belongs only to some configurations                        |

   A sheet used several times carries one ID; its usages become `instances` ([*The definition holds the tr... (XD-ADR-0117)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0117)).
3. List the root schematic in the repo’s `checks.yaml` under `cad.kicad`, then issue the IDs
   and regenerate the CAD needs:
   ```sh
   curatrix ids fix robarm-ee
   curatrix gen cad-needs robarm-ee
   ```

   Commit `generated/cad-needs.json` ([*CAD-derived needs are commi... (XD-ADR-0100)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0100)).
4. Show the schematic in the PCBA document with `kicad-sheet`, `kicad-bom` and `kicad-nets`.
   Make the exports locally with `curatrix gen cad-exports robarm-ee`. In CI the directives show
   a “built locally” notice ([*CI runs without CAD content (XD-ADR-0049)*](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0049)).

## Checks

- [*cad-needs.json matches the ... (XD-CHECK-0019)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0019): `cad-needs.json` matches the KiCad files (plain Python, no KiCad needed).
- [*no orphans (R3) (XD-CHECK-0004)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0004): each element realizes or satisfies something ([*No orphan design elements (XD-RULE-0010)*](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0010)).
- Domain checks such as the netlist against the interface pin maps, and ERC, are commands in the
  repo’s `checks.yaml`.

## Pitfalls

- Hidden fields are easy to lose when you replace a symbol. Check `cad-needs.json` in the diff.
- There is one design document per PCBA and one per prototype configuration ([*One EE document per PCBA an... (XD-ADR-0102)*](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0102)).


# howto/add-a-requirement.html.md

<a id="howto-add-a-requirement"></a>

# Add a requirement

Use this guide when you add a system requirement (`sys-req`) or a domain requirement
(`sw-req`, `ee-req`, `me-req`).

## Steps

1. Open the requirements document of the repo that owns the requirement. System requirements
   live in the syseng repo; domain requirements in their domain repo.
2. Write the need with a **placeholder ID** of the form `<KIND>-NEW-<tag>`. Never invent a
   number ([*No placeholders on main (XD-RULE-0017)*](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0017)).
   ```rst
   .. sys-req:: Follow latency
      :id: SYS-REQ-NEW-latency
      :refines: SYS-NEED-0003
      :ears: ubiquitous
      :category: performance
      :quantity: latency
      :unit: ms
      :max: 50
      :verification_method: test
      :verification_scope: logical

      The system shall move each follower joint within 50 ms of the leader joint.
   ```
3. Write the sentence in an **EARS** pattern ([*Requirements use EARS (XD-ADR-0009)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0009), [*EARS for system and domain ... (XD-ADR-0039)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0039)) and set `:ears:` to
   that pattern ([*Requirements use EARS patterns (XD-RULE-0037)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0037)). Stakeholder needs may be plain statements.
4. Put every number of the sentence into the value fields (`quantity`, `unit`, `min`,
   `max`, `nominal`, [*Requirement values are need... (XD-ADR-0076)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0076)). The check compares them with the sentence ([*Requirement values agree wi... (XD-RULE-0036)*](explanation/rules/checks.html.md#XD-RULE-0036)).
5. Add the upstream link. A system requirement `refines` a stakeholder need. A domain
   requirement `refines` a system requirement or an interface. A domain requirement with no
   upstream link needs `:derived: true` and a `:rationale:`.
6. If the requirement applies only to some configurations, add `:where:` with the feature
   condition ([*Variant fields configs, whe... (XD-ADR-0093)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0093)).
7. Issue the ID:
   ```sh
   curatrix ids fix robarm-syseng
   ```
8. For system requirements, rebuild the docs and the SysML stubs, so the model can refer to the
   new requirement ([*Read-only requirement stubs... (XD-ADR-0036)*](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0036)):
   ```sh
   curatrix docs robarm-syseng
   curatrix gen stubs robarm-syseng
   ```

## Checks

```sh
curatrix check robarm-syseng --stage local
```

- [*no placeholder IDs (XD-CHECK-0013)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0013) and [*IDs in the sources are in t... (XD-CHECK-0014)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0014): no placeholders left, every ID is in the ledger.
- [*requirement values agree wi... (XD-CHECK-0021)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0021) and [*EARS pattern matches the se... (XD-CHECK-0022)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0022): value fields and EARS pattern agree with the sentence.
- [*SysML stubs match the needs (XD-CHECK-0015)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0015): the stubs match the needs.
- [*docs build strict (zdocs, s... (XD-CHECK-0001)*](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0001): the strict docs build; a missing `refines` fails it.

## Pitfalls

- Two PRs may issue the same number. The second one to rebase gets a ledger conflict. Take
  `main`’s ledger and run `curatrix ids fix` again ([*ID collisions show up as gi... (XD-ADR-0122)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0122)).
- Don’t delete a requirement. Set `:status: retired` first ([*IDs are never reused; retir... (XD-RULE-0020)*](explanation/rules/ids.html.md#XD-RULE-0020)).


# howto/add-a-test.html.md

<a id="howto-add-a-test"></a>

# Add a test

Use this guide when you add a test case and want its results to count as evidence.

## Where the test lives

Tests live by what they verify ([*Tests live by what they verify (XD-ADR-0104)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0104)):

- A test that verifies a system requirement or an interface is a system test case (`INT-STC`)
  or an integration test case (`INT-ITC`) in the integration repo, even if it touches one
  domain only.
- A test of a domain requirement stays in its domain repo: `SW-TC`, `EE-TC` or `ME-TC`.

## Steps

1. Write the test case with a `verifies` link to the requirement. For authored test cases
   (rst):
   ```rst
   .. int-itc:: Servo PWM on the joint connector
      :id: INT-ITC-NEW-pwm
      :verifies: SYS-IF-0002
   ```

   For Zephyr tests, the ID goes into the ZTEST comment and is written there by a tool
   ([*SW test case IDs come from ... (XD-ADR-0073)*](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0073)); the `\verifies` tag makes the link.
2. If the test runs only on some configurations, set `configs`.
3. Issue the ID:
   ```sh
   curatrix ids fix robarm-integration
   ```
4. Run the test. Results become test result needs (`TR-<test case ID>-<run hash>`) with a
   `result_of` link to the test case and the `config` they ran on.

## Evidence rules
